question: Ustad Latafat Hussain Khan is associated with the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agra gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• Ustad Latafat Hussain Khan was a prominent Indian classical vocalist associated with the Agra gharana.

• The Agra gharana is known for its emphasis on developing a full-throated voice and a wide range of improvisation techniques.

• It has made significant contributions to the Khayal form of singing, which is a major genre of Hindustani classical music.

• Some other notable exponents of the Agra gharana include Ustad Faiyaz Khan and Ustad Vilayat
